besluite.fout: Two separate imperative clauses joined by 'of' without the comma, so 'of laat die punt uit' can be read as part of the dat-clause.
besluite.rede: The comma before 'of' joining two main clauses follows the AWS 2017 and removes a misreading without changing the two options.

besluite.fout: Positive 'saak maak' copies English 'matters'; Afrikaans uses it naturally mainly in the negative.
besluite.rede: 'Belangrik is' is plainer, idiomatic Afrikaans for a Grade 6 reader and says the same thing; no protected wording or neighbour is touched.
